newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 304 OF NOVEMBER 27, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 304 OF NOVEMBER 27, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COUNCIL DIRECTIVE 96/75/EC of 19 November 1996 on the systems of chartering and pricing in national and international inland waterway transport in the Community

COUNCIL DIRECTIVE 96/72/EC of 18 November 1996 amending Directives 66/400/EEC, 66/401/EEC, 66/402/EEC, 66/403/EEC, 69/208/EEC and 70/458/EEC on the marketing of beet seed, fodder plant seed, cereal seed, seed potatoes, seed of oil and fibre plants and vegetable seed

COMMISSION DECISION of 14 November 1996 adapting pursuant to Article 42 (3), Annex II to Council Regulation (EEC) No 259/93 on the supervision and control of shipments of waste within, into and out of the European Community (Text with EEA relevance)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2257/96 of 26 November 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2256/96 of 26 November 1996 amending the import duties in the cereals sector
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 2255/96 of 19 November 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1107/70 on the granting of aids for transport by rail, road and inland waterway
